name: N- and O-glycan synthesis with fucosylation and selectin ligands
rationale: All members concern protein glycan synthesis (N-glycan trimming/elongation, mucin O-GalNAc glycosylation, sialylation, defects), and unlike the sialic-acid/nucleotide-sugar and GAG confusables the theme carries GDP-fucose, Lewis/ABO antigens, tyrosine sulfation and leukocyte rolling/HSC homing, i.e. fucosylated selectin-ligand formation.

name: Antigen processing and presentation, predominantly MHC class II
rationale: All members are antigen processing/presentation terms centred on exogenous peptide presentation via MHC class II (germinal-centre B cells, MHC-TLR7-TLR8 cluster), distinguishing it from MHC class I cross-presentation and regulatory-term confusables.

name: Neuronal microtubule cargo transport, tubulin glutamylation and severing
rationale: Members cover kinesin-driven axonal/dendritic transport of vesicles, mitochondria and receptors together with tubulin C-terminal (poly)glutamylation and microtubule severing, the latter being what all confusables lack.

core: Cellular cholesterol efflux and HDL assembly
name: Macrophage cholesterol efflux, HDL assembly and foam cell regulation
rationale: Members share ABCA1/apoA-I/LXR-driven cholesterol efflux and HDL formation, and unlike the HDL-remodelling and reverse-transport confusables they include oxLDL response, cholesterol storage/import and foam cell differentiation.

name: Inherited adrenal steroidogenic cytochrome P450 enzyme deficiencies
rationale: All five members are defects in adrenal steroidogenic CYPs (CYP11A1, CYP17A1, CYP21A2, CYP11B1, CYP11B2) causing adrenal hyperplasia/insufficiency, whereas confusables are normal sex-steroid or mineralocorticoid biosynthesis terms.

qualifier: lens, anterior segment and hyaloid regression
name: Eye morphogenesis: lens, anterior segment, hyaloid vessel regression
rationale: All members are eye developmental processes, and unlike the photoreceptor/retinal-neuron and retinal-vasculature confusables they emphasise lens fibre development and transparency, cornea/iris/eyelid, optic cup/nerve and hyaloid vessel regression.

name: Hematopoietic interleukin receptor signaling: IL-2/7/9 and IL-3/5
rationale: All members are signalling by hematopoietic cytokine receptors (common gamma-chain IL-2/7/9, beta-common IL-3/5, SHC adaptor, G-CSF inactivation, IL2-STAT5), distinguishing it from IL-6/gp130, IL-15/21 T-cell and FLT3 confusables.

core: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen metabolism
name: Glutamate-glutamine nitrogen metabolism and glycine/glutamine aromatic acid conjugation
rationale: Members centre on glutamate/glutamine/aspartate and nitrogen metabolism plus mitochondrial glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, which separates it from alanine/gluconeogenesis and proline/glycine confusables.

name: Regulation of Fas/TRAIL death receptor-induced apoptosis
rationale: All members concern Fas/FasL and TRAIL death-receptor apoptotic signalling and its positive/negative regulation (T-cell AICD, thymocyte and hepatocyte apoptosis, BID activation), whereas confusables centre on caspase-8/c-FLIP and T-cell signalling modules.

name: RhoA, RhoB and RhoC GTPase cycles
rationale: The three members are the RHOA, RHOB and RHOC GTPase cycles, distinguishing them from Rac, Cdc42, RhoG/J/D/U/V cycle and actin-protrusion confusables.

name: Oxidative and nitrosative stress response and ROS detoxification
rationale: Members share cellular responses to ROS/RNS (H2O2, NO, hydroperoxide, ischemia) and antioxidant control (ROS detoxification, HMOX1/BACH1, MTF1, redox homeostasis), unlike the confusables that centre on respiration control and oxidative-stress apoptosis.

qualifier: face, palate, limbs, pharyngeal glands, spleen
name: Embryonic face, limb, pharyngeal gland and spleen morphogenesis
rationale: All members are embryonic morphogenesis of face/palate/outer ear, limbs/digits, pharyngeal-derived glands (thyroid, parathyroid, thymus) and spleen, distinguishing it from neural plate/head patterning and cardiac neural crest confusables.

name: CHD/NuRD chromatin remodeling and nucleosome organization
rationale: Members share nucleosome assembly/disassembly and chromatin-level transcriptional co-regulation (CHD1/2 and CHD6-9 subfamilies, NuRD-TF interactions, histone arginine methylation, E2F6, RUNX1 cofactors), and the CHD/NuRD remodelers are what the BAF/HAT and DNA-repair chromatin confusables lack.

name: Sema3A-plexin repulsive axon guidance and innervation
rationale: Members are Sema3A-plexin repulsion (CRMPs, PAK, integrin inhibition) with axon guidance, sympathetic projection extension and innervation axonogenesis, distinguishing it from Sema4D, netrin and axon regeneration confusables.

name: Lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and TCA cycle
rationale: Members share the lipoate/DLD-dependent PDH, OGDH and OADH complexes (with protein lipoylation, glycine cleavage, lysine catabolism) feeding the TCA cycle, which separates them from respiratory-chain, CoA/PDH-regulation and serine/B6 confusables.

name: Lung epithelial branching morphogenesis and lobe growth
rationale: All members concern lung branching, bud elongation, epithelial proliferation, growth and lobe development, distinguishing it from lung mesenchyme, saccule/pneumocyte and other-organ branching confusables.

name: Glycogen storage diseases of defective glycogen synthesis
rationale: All four members are glycogen storage diseases caused by loss of glycogen-building enzymes (GYS1, GYS2, GBE1, GYG1), unlike confusables covering glucose-6-phosphatase defects, glycogenolysis and glucokinase.

name: Erythroid differentiation and terminal red cell maturation
rationale: Members cover primitive/definitive erythrocyte differentiation, enucleation, red cell membrane assembly and oxygen transport with erythroid transcriptional modules, distinguishing it from HSC homeostasis, megakaryocyte, myeloid progenitor and heme confusables.

core: Adipose tissue development and adipocyte differentiation
name: White adipocyte differentiation, adipose development and PPAR-gamma regulation
rationale: Members share white fat cell differentiation/proliferation, fat pad and adipose development and positive/negative control of PPAR(-gamma) signalling, distinguishing it from PGC-1alpha/circadian, brown/beige adipocyte and LXR lipid-metabolism confusables.

core: Gluconeogenic amino acid and quaternary amine metabolism
name: Alanine/threonine gluconeogenic and choline/carnitine metabolism
rationale: Members combine alanine/threonine catabolism with oxaloacetate and gluconeogenesis and choline catabolism with carnitine synthesis, which together separate it from glutamate/aromatic amino acid, fatty acyl-CoA and biotin/FMO confusables.

name: FXII-kallikrein contact activation and fibrinolysis regulation
rationale: Members centre on FXIIa/plasma kallikrein contact activation of the intrinsic pathway (including amyloid-triggered FXII, C1-inhibitor/FXII angioedema) and plasminogen activation/fibrin dissolution, distinguishing it from VWF, extrinsic/common coagulation and MMP confusables.

core: MHC class I antigen processing and presentation
name: Proteasomal MHC class I presentation and immune receptor degradation
rationale: Members share proteasome/ERAD-dependent processing for MHC class I presentation and cross-presentation together with degradation of immune surface proteins (PD-L1, and Nef/Vpu targets CD4, CD8, CD28, MHC-I), which the MHC class II and dendritic-cell confusables lack.

name: p53-mediated G1/G2 DNA damage checkpoint arrest after irradiation
rationale: Members cover p53 stabilisation/phosphorylation and its transcription of G1 and G2 arrest genes, Cdc25A degradation and responses to gamma/X-rays, unlike confusables centred on p53 DNA-repair targets and G2/M recovery.

name: Amyloid-beta production, clearance and glial activation regulation
rationale: Members regulate amyloid-beta formation, fibrillisation and clearance with associated ectodomain shedding, synaptic LTP suppression and microglia/astrocyte activation and proliferation, distinguishing it from microglial effector, APP biosynthesis and tangle confusables.

name: Xenobiotic biotransformation by CYP2E1, methylation and acetylation
rationale: All members are xenobiotic/plant-compound metabolism (benzenoids, alkaloids, phenylpropanoids, paracetamol), and the CYP2E1 oxidation plus methylation/acetylation conjugation distinguishes it from sulfonation, glycine-conjugation and CYP1A2/FMO confusables.
